mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% indicates accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuations, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to compressed cost of capital.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5% over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate rise above 5.0% in 3 months signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce corporate earnings growth expectations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0% over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) above their 3-month moving averages indicates robust consumer demand, boosting corporate earnings expectations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both above 3-month average
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS exceed 3-month moving averages.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production (INDPRO < 100) signals supply chain disruptions that increase inflation expectations and reduce corporate profitability, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days during supply-constrained environments.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 100 over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A CPI index above 240 (CPIAUCSL > 240) signals elevated inflation that triggers aggressive Federal Reserve rate hike expectations, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 240 over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A total nonfarm employment level above 140,000 thousand (PAYEMS > 140000) indicates a robust labor market that sustains consumer spending and corporate profitability, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS > 140000 over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When retail sales (RSAFS) exceed 450,000 million dollars, it signals strong consumer demand that boosts corporate revenue growth expectations, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days during demand-driven expansions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS > 450000 over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO < 100) and rise in CPI (CPIAUCSL > 240) signals stagflationary pressures that increase market uncertainty and reduce equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 100 and CPIAUCSL > 240 over a 5-year rolling window.
